No reserve co-optimization at ANY completion level can price scarcity while the model's own deliverable-reserve state there is slack by 1.6-10.5 GW. The armed design is provably inert on this keeper (§B: strictly positive slack in all 26,280 h at every supply tier ⇒ zero shortfall and zero reserve duals at every optimum), so the in-LP route is closed as a matter of the model's STATE, not of mechanism granularity — the rule-19 [R-ONE-MECH] scarcity-owner question is fully adjudicated on the in-LP side.
  • §D OVERLAY TIMING — the caiso-137b charter question (should the scored backcast lane carry a scarcity-pricing overlay at all?) is ANSWERED NEGATIVE BY MEASUREMENT, not refused on admissibility. Reproducing the forecast-path LOLP overlay on the keeper's committed bytes with r_online deliberately UNDER-stated (an over-estimate of the adder), its >$200 settle hours overlap reality's tail in 1 of 47 hours (2023) and 0 of 35 (2024) — ≤1 hour in 90 over three years. It fires Apr-Nov when the MODEL is tight; reality was tight on winter mornings. Wiring it into the scored lane closes nothing and invents a mis-timed tail.
  • §E WHAT THE TAIL ACTUALLY IS — a WINTER-MORNING fuel/cold-snap tail already priced to its measured input ceiling. The keeper carries the measured daily-spot citygate fuel input at flow-date placement (caiso_citygate_spot_level + caiso_citygate_flow_date, both armed); at Jan-2023's measured $16-18/MMBtu daily spot the marginal-heat-rate SRMC is $150-180/MWh — exactly where the model prints (max zonal λ $181 in 2023 / $155 in 2024 in those hours). The wedge above that ceiling is the RT premium above same-day fuel cost (deliverability/OFO events, cold-snap WECC-wide import conduct, sub-hourly ramp formation), which has no admissible hourly-LP representation on the inputs in hand.
IN-MODEL QUEUE EMPTY ON EVERY ROUTE at adoption: offer rungs closed (caiso-131 §10), reserve tiers closed (caiso-144 §B/§C, matrix energy_reserve_coopt / reserve_pergen CAISO → I), overlay refused on measurement (§D), fuel grain already armed to its measured daily ceiling (§E).
